# Epping Car Buyer

> Independent mobile pre-purchase car inspections, EV and plug-in hybrid battery health checks, and a managed "Market & Sell" car-selling service. Based near Epping, Essex, covering Essex, Hertfordshire, Greater London, South Cambridgeshire, Bedfordshire and Suffolk.

Epping Car Buyer is run by Henry, who travels to the car, wherever it is for sale. Open Monday to Saturday, 09:00 to 18:00. Phone and WhatsApp: 01992 367909. Email: henry@eppingcarbuyer.com. Website: https://www.eppingcarbuyer.com

## Services

- [Vehicle inspections](https://www.eppingcarbuyer.com/vehicle-inspections): Standard (from £149.99, 160-point) and Premium (£199.99, 260-point) pre-purchase inspections with diagnostics, road test, history check, video review, photo evidence, same-day report and personal buying guidance.
- [What we inspect](https://www.eppingcarbuyer.com/vehicle-inspections/what-we-inspect): the full 260-point Premium checklist.
- [EV and hybrid battery health check](https://www.eppingcarbuyer.com/ev-battery-health-check): CARA Approved Autel State of Health report for compatible electric and plug-in hybrid cars, £99.99 on its own or £49.99 with an inspection.
- [Market & Sell](https://www.eppingcarbuyer.com/market-and-sell): we market and sell your car for you, aiming closer to retail value than a trade sale. No upfront cost, no sale, no fee.
- [Book an inspection](https://www.eppingcarbuyer.com/vehicle-inspections/book): choose a package, pick a time and pay securely online.
